canonical_definition: Parietal, distance separating supratemporal fenestrae: less than (0) or twice (1) the long axis of supratemporal fenestra.
Supraoccipital, height: twice (0) subequal to or less than (1) height of foramen magnum.
Paroccipital process, ventral nonarticular pro- cess: absent (0); present (1).
Cervical vertebrae, number: 9 or fewer (0); 10 (1); 12 (2); 13 (3); 15 or greater (4).
Mid-cervical centra, anteroposterior length/ height of posterior face: 2.5-3.0 (0); > 4 (1).
Posterior dorsal neural arches, hyposphene- hypantrum articulations: present (0); absent (1).
Anterior caudal centra (excluding the first), articular face shape: amphiplatyan or platy- coelous (0); procoelous (1); opisthocoelous (2).
Scapular glenoid, orientation: relatively flat or laterally facing (0); strongly bevelled medially (1).
Humerus-to-femur ratio: less than 0.60 (0); 0.60 or more (1).
